name: Security Scanning
display_title: KS-938: MFA disable and revert NULL the TOTP seed and the backup codes

head_commit.message:
KS-938: MFA disable and revert NULL the TOTP seed and the backup codes

All three MFA-clearing sites passed `undefined`, which updateUser skips, so a
PARTIAL update landed: the flag flipped, the call answered 200 "MFA disabled
successfully", and a live re-armable TOTP seed plus unspent hashed backup codes
stayed in the row. The fix is per-site, not one shared edit, because
users.ts POST /me/mfa/disable did not pass mfaBackupCodes at all.

updateUser's undefined-skip is deliberately NOT changed: other callers rely on
it to mean "leave this column alone". null passes the guard and writes SQL NULL.

Residue named, not fixed: users.ts verifies the TOTP only if a seed exists.

Refs KS-938
